name: Nishad Singh

summary.text: Nishad Singh was FTX's director of engineering. He pleaded guilty, cooperated with prosecutors and testified against Sam Bankman-Fried. On October 30, 2024 U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan sentenced him to time served and three years of supervised release, with prosecutors saying he had provided 'substantial assistance' to the government.

sources.title: Ex-FTX engineering head avoids prison, sentenced to 3 years supervised release

facts.claim: On October 30, 2024 Judge Lewis Kaplan sentenced Singh, FTX's former engineering director, to time served plus three years of supervised release.

facts.claim: Prosecutors said Singh provided 'substantial assistance' to the government in its case against Bankman-Fried, and the judge credited his cooperation.

facts.claim: Singh's time-served sentence was later matched by that of FTX co-founder Gary Wang in November 2024.
